title: Soup loop feedback record
description: One line per feedback action on one answer, appended to .soup-loops/feedback.jsonl (default layout). A change is a new line: for kind thumb, rating and edit the latest line per (response_id, kind) wins; comment lines accumulate. A thumb or rating with value null, or an edit with edited_text null, clears the earlier one. Readers ignore unknown fields.

response_id.description: The `id` of the conversation record (the answer) this feedback is about.

value.description: thumb: 1 (up), -1 (down) or null (cleared). rating: integer 1-5 or null (cleared). Ignored for edit and comment.

edited_text.description: kind edit: the answer as the user corrected it; null withdraws an earlier edit.

comment.description: Free text. Required for kind comment; optional next to any other kind.

user_ref.description: Opaque reference the application chose for the person (a single desktop user writes local). Soup stores no other author data.

^x_[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$.description: Producer extension namespace (x_<app>). Soup never reads or rewrites it.

uuid.description: A UUID in canonical lowercase form.

utc_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, suffix Z or +00:00.

source.description: Which surface produced the record. Known values: soup-serve (soup serve), playground, try_it, proxy (consuming applications). Other lowercase names are accepted.
